blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Real-to-simulation transfer, which builds simulations from real-world observations, has long been studied in research and industry. Recently, coding agents have become capable of generating simulation programs from video recordings, and several benchmarks have been proposed to evaluate them. However, each individual benchmark defines its own inputs, deliverables, and scoring pipeline. This leads to $N \times M$ integrations when evaluating $N$ methods on $M$ benchmarks. To this end, we present Real2SimLab, a unified platform for real-to-simulation transfer. It evaluates a method by running its written program and scoring the output simulation with the original scorer of each benchmark. Moreover, Real2SimLab provides a pipeline to create training data and reward annotations for real-to-simulation methods. Our pipeline carefully avoids data contamination by filtering out the video recordings that exist in benchmarks. For each video recording, a program is first produced, and then our pipeline computes its reward with the same code that Real2SimLab uses for evaluation. So far, it supports 47 coding agents and 5 non-agent methods on 6 benchmarks. Both the platform and Awesome-Real2Sim, our research map of nearly 300 real-to-simulation papers, are open source, and we invite the Real2SimHub community to build them together.
blocks.zh: 真实到模拟的转录,从真实世界的观测中构建出模拟,长期被研究和工业所研究. 最近,编码代理已经有能力从录相中生成模拟程序,并提出了几个评价基准. 然而,每个基准都确定了自己的投入、可交付成果和评分管道。 这导致在按百万美元基准评价美元方法时,将百万美元纳入其中。 为此,我们提出Real2SimLab,一个实现真实到模拟传输的统一平台. 它通过运行其书面程序来评价一种方法,并用每个基准的原始计分器来评分输出模拟. 此外,Real2SimLab还提供一条管道,为真实到模拟方法创建培训数据和奖励说明. 我们的管道通过过滤基准中存在的录像,小心避免数据被污染。 每次录相,首先制作一个程序,然后我们的管道用Real2SimLab用于评价的同一种代码计算它的奖励. 迄今为止,它支持47个编码剂和6个基准上的5个非代理方法. 平台和Aweasy-Real2Sim,即我们近300个真实到模拟论文的研究地图,都是开源的,我们邀请Real2SimHub社区共同建造.

blocks.en: 1  Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Real-to-simulation transfer has long been an active topic in both research and industry.
It takes real-world observations, such as images, videos, and 3D scans, to build simulations in which real objects, scenes, and events can be reproduced, analyzed, and reused.
This field spans computer vision, graphics, and robotics, and most of its methods are designed for one kind of input and one kind of output.
For example, some methods fit physical parameters, such as mass and friction, to videos of objects [ 35 , 36 , 15 , 20 , 16 ] , some assign physical properties to reconstructed 3D scenes [ 37 , 41 ] , and others build sensor simulators from real scans [ 23 ] or simulated training environments for robots from real rooms [ 34 , 10 ] .
Each of these methods is a dedicated pipeline, which requires a new pipeline for a new kind of scene.
blocks.zh:
真实到模拟转移长期以来一直是研究和工业中一个活跃的话题.
它需要真实世界的观察,如图像,视频,和3D扫描,来构建模拟,在模拟中,真实的物体,场景,事件可以复制,分析,再利用.
这个领域涵盖计算机视觉,图形和机器人,它的大部分方法都是为一种输入和一种输出而设计的.
例如,有些方法适合物体的视频[35,36,15,20,16]的物理参数,例如质量和摩擦,有些方法指定物理属性重建3D场景[37,41],有些方法通过真实扫描构建传感器模拟器[23],或者为来自真实房间的机器人模拟训练环境[34,10].
每一种方法都是专用管道,这需要一个新的管道来进行新的场景.

blocks.en:
Recently, rapid progress in foundation models, such as Claude Fable 5.2 [ 2 ] and GPT-6 [ 25 ] , has made coding agents capable of writing and debugging large programs in an evolving way.
This capability opens a new paradigm for real-to-simulation transfer (Figure 1 , panel 1): instead of building a dedicated pipeline for each kind of scene, one can ask a coding agent to write a simulation program directly from a video recording [ 8 , 7 ] .
For example, given a video of a red drink being poured into a glass, an agent can write a program that sets up the glass and the liquid in a physics simulator and reproduces the pour.
While the video shows the event only once and from one viewpoint, the program can replay the event, render it from new viewpoints, and expose the state of every object at every moment.
The same agent can attempt many kinds of scenes, offering a promising step toward building simulations in an automatic way.
In this paper, we focus on such a setting, in which a method, such as a coding agent, receives a video recording and delivers a simulation program that can be run.
blocks.zh:
最近,基础模型的快速进展,如Claude Fable 5.2[2]和GPT-6[25],使得编码代理能够以不断发展的方式编写和调试大型程序.
这种能力开启了真实到模拟传输的新范式(图1,面板1):人们可以不为每一种场景建造专用管道,而是要求编码代理直接从视频录制中写出模拟程序[8,7].
例如,给一个将红酒倒入玻璃的视频,代理人可以写一个程序,在物理模拟器中设置玻璃和液体,并复制倒注.
虽然视频只从一个角度显示事件一次,但程序可以重播事件,从新角度渲染,并随时暴露每个物体的状态.
同样的特工可以尝试多种场景,为自动建立模拟提供了有希望的一步.
在本文中,我们专注于这样的设定,在这样的设定中,一个方法,如编码代理,接收一个视频录音,并交付一个可以运行的模拟程序.

blocks.en:
Figure 2: Why a shared platform helps. (a) Without a shared platform, benchmarks differ in what they provide to a method, what they ask the method to deliver, and how they score the output. Every pair of a method and a benchmark thus requires its own adapter to run.
(b) Real2SimLab makes the delivered program into the interface between methods and benchmarks. So each method and each benchmark is integrated only once.
blocks.zh:
图 2:为什么共享平台有帮助. (a) 没有共同的平台,基准在提供方法、要求交付方法以及如何对产出进行评分方面各不相同。 因此,每对方法和基准都需要自己的适配器运行。
(b) Real2SimLab使交付的程序成为方法和基准之间的接口。 因此,每种方法和每个基准都只整合一次。

blocks.en:
To measure the progress of the methods, several benchmarks have been proposed [ 24 , 18 , 32 , 30 , 33 , 19 ] .
They contribute valuable recordings, carefully designed tasks, and metrics.
However, each benchmark defines its own inputs, deliverables, and scoring pipeline.
For example, Physics-IQ [ 24 ] gives a method the first three seconds of a real video and scores the video frames that the method produces for the next five seconds, whereas Video2World [ 33 ] gives a whole robot manipulation video and asks for a simulation package that contains the reconstructed scene and the actions of the robot.
Other benchmarks ask for other types of deliverables: 4DCodeBench [ 32 ] asks for a script that builds a 4D world, that is, a 3D scene that changes over time, and PhysCodeGym [ 30 ] asks for a Blender scene that reproduces a reference video.
Each benchmark then scores its deliverable with its own code, in its own software environment.
As a result, a method built for one benchmark cannot be evaluated on another without a dedicated adapter, and evaluating N N methods on M M benchmarks requires N × M N\times M integrations (Figure 2 a).
This cost discourages the evaluation of a method on more than a few benchmarks, and it is also hard to compare the results from different papers.
blocks.zh:
为衡量方法的进展情况,提出了若干基准[24、18、32、30、33、19]。
它们贡献了宝贵的录音、精心设计的任务和衡量标准。
然而,每个基准都确定了自己的投入、可交付成果和评分管道。
例如,Physics-IQ [24]给出了真视频的前三秒的方法,并给该方法为接下来的5秒制作的视频帧打分,而Video2World [33]则给出了完整的机器人操纵视频,并要求提供包含重建场景和机器人动作的模拟包.
其他基准则要求其他类型的交付品: 4DCode Bench [32] 要求建立一个4D世界的脚本,即一个随时间变化的3D场景, PhysCodeGym [30] 要求一个Blender场景复制一个参考视频.
然后,每个基准在自己的软件环境中,用自己的代码对其交付品进行评分。
因此,在没有专用适配器的情况下,为一个基准制定的方法不能在另一个基准上评价,在MM基准上评价N N方法需要N×M N\times M集成(图2 a).
这一费用不利于对不止几个基准的方法进行评价,而且很难比较不同文件的结果。

blocks.en:
To this end, we present Real2SimLab , a unified platform for real-to-simulation transfer (Figure 1 , panel 2).
It first runs the program that a method writes and scores the output simulation with the original scorer of a benchmark.
Since every method delivers a program and every benchmark scores what a program outputs, the program becomes a common interface between the two sides (Figure 2 b).
On the method side, each method is connected once, through a method-wise adapter that passes a task to the method and collects its program.
On the benchmark side, each benchmark is connected once, through a benchmark-wise adapter that converts its data into tasks of one shared format and keeps the official scorer.
For example, on Physics-IQ, a method now delivers a program that writes the requested frames, and the official scorer evaluates these frames as the original benchmark.
Evaluating N N methods on M M benchmarks then requires only N + M N+M integrations instead of N × M N\times M .
blocks.zh:
为此,我们提出Real2SimLab,一个实现真实到模拟传输的统一平台(图1,面板2).
它首先运行一个方法用基准的原始计分器编写和评分输出模拟的程序.
由于每一种方法都交付一个程序,每个基准都得分什么是程序输出,所以程序成为双方的共同接口(图2 b).
在方法方面,每种方法都会通过一个方法性适配器连接一次,这个适配器将一个任务传递给方法并收集其程序.
在基准方面,每个基准通过一个基于基准的适配器连接一次,该适配器将数据转换成一个共享格式的任务,并保留官方计分器.
例如,在Physics-IQ上,一种方法现在提供一个程序来写入请求的帧,官方计分员评价这些帧作为原始的基准.
在MM基准上评价NN方法,则只需要N+M N+M集成,而不是N×M N\times M.

blocks.en:
Moreover, Real2SimLab provides a pipeline that creates training data with reward annotations for real-to-simulation methods.
These training data should be free of contamination. However, data contamination oftentimes happens in real-to-simulation transfer since one recording can appear in several datasets. For example, one benchmark could reuse the video clips from another benchmark.
The pipeline therefore compares the frames of every training recording with those of the evaluation tasks, and it filters out the recordings that appear in the evaluation tasks, including copies that are re-encoded, resized, or clipped.
For each remaining recording, a method first writes a program, and the pipeline then computes the reward of this program with the same code that Real2SimLab uses for evaluation.
Real2SimLab does not train models itself. Instead, the resulting programs and rewards can serve both offline fine-tuning and online reinforcement learning.
blocks.zh:
此外,Real2SimLab还提供一条管道,用于创建培训数据,并附有真实到模拟方法的奖励说明。
这些培训数据应不受污染。 然而,数据污染往往发生在真实到模拟的传输中,因为一个记录可以在几个数据集中出现. 例如,一个基准可以重新使用另一个基准的录像片段。
因此,该管道将每次培训记录的框架与评价任务的框架进行比较,并过滤出评价任务中出现的记录,包括重新编码、调整大小或剪辑的拷贝。
对于每个剩下的录音,一个方法首先写一个程序,然后管道用Real2SimLab用于评价的相同代码计算这个程序的奖励.
Real2SimLab本身并不训练模型. 相反,由此产生的方案和奖励既可以用于线下微调,也可以用于在线强化学习。

blocks.en:
So far, Real2SimLab supports 47 coding agents and 5 non-agent methods, and it adapts 6 existing benchmarks.
All 47 agents, such as OpenHands and Aider, connect through a bridge to the Harbor framework [ 13 ] , and 5 widely used ones, such as Codex, Claude Code, and Gemini CLI, can also run directly in the sandboxes of Real2SimLab.
The 6 benchmarks are Physics-IQ, Video2World, 4DCodeBench, PhysCodeGym, PhySimCode, and IRIS, to which we add a synthetic suite with exact ground truth, and we check each benchmark-wise adapter against the original release of its benchmark.
This paper focuses on the design of the platform, and we leave a systematic comparison of the connected methods to future work.
blocks.zh:
迄今为止,Real2SimLab支持47个编码代理和5个非代理方法,并调整了6个现有基准.
所有47个代理,如OpenHands和Aider,通过一座桥连接到港务框架[13],5个广泛使用的代理,如Codex,Claude Code,和双子座CLI,也可以在Real2SimLab的沙盒中直接运行.
这6个基准是Physics-IQ, Video2World, 4DCode Bench, PhysCodeGym, PhySimCode, 和IRIS, 我们增加了一个具有准确地面真实性的合成套件, 我们对照其基准的原始发布来检查每个基准适配器.
本文侧重于平台的设计,我们将相关方法的系统比较留待未来工作.

blocks.en:
Last but not least, while positioning a new work, it is challenging to efficiently choose baseline methods and benchmarks. This is because the literature of real-to-simulation transfer scatters over multiple fields, including computer vision, graphics, and robotics.
These papers deliver the results in various ways and styles, from physical parameters and simulation-ready assets to scene-level simulations, simulation programs, and learned simulators.
We therefore also release Awesome-Real2Sim , a research map of nearly 300 real-to-simulation papers (Figure 1 , panel 3).
It organizes the papers by motivations or deliverables, and we will keep it up to date as new work appears.
blocks.zh:
最后但并非最不重要的是,在确定新工作时,有效选择基准方法和基准是一项挑战。 这是因为真实到模拟转移的文献 散落在多个领域, 包括计算机视觉、图形和机器人。
这些论文以不同的方式和风格,从物理参数和模拟准备资产到场景模拟,模拟程序,以及学习的模拟器,来传达结果.
因此,我们还发布了Awesome-Real2Sim,一张近300份真实到模拟文件的研究地图(图1,第3版)。
它根据动机或可达到的目标来组织文件,我们将随着新工作的出现不断更新。

blocks.en:
Both the platform and the research map are open source, and we hope that they will grow into a shared effort of Real2SimHub , an open community that we started around both projects, with a website linked under the paper title.
Researchers can connect their own methods, benchmarks, and datasets through the same adapters that we develop, and add their papers to the research map.
blocks.zh:
平台和研究地图都是开源的,我们希望它们会成长为Real2SimHub的共同努力,我们围绕这两个项目开始了一个开放社区,该网站在纸质标题下链接起来。
研究人员可以通过我们开发的同样的适配器连接自己的方法,基准和数据集,并将其论文添加到研究地图中.

blocks.en:
Our contributions are as follows: • A unified evaluation platform. Real2SimLab considers the program that a method delivers as the common interface between methods and benchmarks. As a result, N N methods and M M benchmarks need only N + M N+M integrations. • A pipeline that can create training data and avoid contamination. Real2SimLab creates training data by filtering the video recordings that appear in any evaluation task, and provides the reward scores for future fine-tuning. • An open-source ecosystem that is easy to use and extend. So far, Real2SimLab supports 47 coding agents and 5 non-agent methods on 6 existing benchmarks.
Users can combine them in a short experiment file and add new methods or benchmarks as plugins. • An up-to-date research map. Awesome-Real2Sim organizes nearly 300 real-to-simulation papers by motivation or deliverable, and we will keep extending it as new work appears.

blocks.en: 2  Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Table 1: Real2SimLab among the evaluation platforms of other fields. Each platform contributes to a research field by offering a shared way to evaluate many methods or systems.
Real2SimLab aims to play this role for real-to-simulation, where the method to be tested delivers a simulation program.
blocks.zh:
表1:其他领域的评价平台中的Real2SimLab。 每个平台都通过提供评价许多方法或系统的共同方式,为研究领域做出贡献。
Real2SimLab旨在发挥这个作用,用于真实到模拟,在那里测试的方法会提供模拟程序.

blocks.en:
Several fields already share an evaluation platform (Table 1 ).
For language models, lm-evaluation-harness [ 6 ] and HELM [ 22 ] run many models on many tasks with shared metrics, and OpenCompass [ 26 ] and VLMEvalKit [ 11 ] extend this practice to vision–language models.
For agents, SWE-bench [ 17 ] scores the patches of coding agents by running unit tests in containers, and Harbor [ 13 ] runs agents on tasks in containers and checks each task with its own verifier.
For robot policies, SIMPLER [ 21 ] evaluates policies in simulated versions of real setups, RoboArena [ 3 ] ranks policies through pairwise comparisons on real robots, and XPolicyLab [ 9 ] connects N N policies to M M evaluation environments with N + M N+M integrations.
Real2SimLab aims to play the same role for real-to-simulation transfer, and like XPolicyLab, it connects methods and benchmarks through adapters.
What passes between the two sides is different, however.
A robot policy is a live model that the environment queries step by step, whereas a method in Real2SimLab delivers a program once, at the end of its work.
Unlike a live policy, a program can be run again after the session in which it was written, so Real2SimLab fixes how the program is packaged and re-runs it offline before scoring it (Section 3.3 ).
This re-run also distinguishes Real2SimLab from Harbor, whose verifier checks the container in which the agent worked, whereas Real2SimLab scores a frozen re-run of the program outside that container, with the original scorer of each benchmark.
The two platforms are nevertheless complementary, since Real2SimLab runs the agents of Harbor through a bridge and can export its own tasks as Harbor tasks.
blocks.zh:
几个领域已经共享了评价平台(表1)。
对于语言模型,lm-valuation-harness [6] 和HELM [22] 在许多任务上使用共享的度量标准运行许多模型,OpenCompass [26]和VLMEvalKit [11] 将这种做法扩展到视觉-语言模型.
对于代理商,SWE-bench [17]通过在集装箱中运行单元测试对编码代理的补丁进行评分,而港[13]则运行代理商在集装箱中执行任务,并以自己的核查员检查每个任务.
对于机器人政策,SIMPLER[21]通过模拟真实设置版本评价政策,RoboArena[3]通过对真实机器人的对等比较对政策进行排序,XPolicyLab[9]连接 N政策到MM评价环境与N+M N+M整合.
Real2SimLab旨在为真实到模拟传输发挥同样的作用,和XPolicyLab一样,它通过适配器连接方法和基准.
然而,双方之间的往来是不同的。
机器人政策是环境查询一步一步的直播模式,而Real2SimLab中的一种方法在工作结束时提供一次程序.
与直播政策不同,一个程序可以在写完的会话后再次运行,因此Real2SimLab在打分前会修正程序如何包装并重新运行下线(第3.3节).
这个重运行还区分了Real2SimLab和Harbor,后者的核查员检查了代理工作所在的容器,而Real2SimLab则在该容器外对程序进行冷冻重运行,每个基准的原始计分员.
然而,这两个平台是互补的,因为Real2SimLab通过一座桥梁管理港湾的代理人,并且可以作为港湾任务输出自己的任务.

blocks.en:
Figure 3: A roadmap of real-to-simulation, from Awesome-Real2Sim. Selected methods (gray) and benchmarks (violet) are placed by the month of their first arXiv version (for Galileo, which has none, by the month of its conference).
Each card names the institution and what the paper delivers or asks for.
The methods deliver many kinds of results, such as physical twins (fitted or assigned), simulation-ready assets, scene twins, learned simulators, and simulation programs.
One recent trend is that coding agents write simulation programs, and recent benchmarks such as 4DCodeBench, PhysCodeGym, and Video2World are proposed to evaluate these agents.
blocks.zh:
图3:真实到模拟的路线图,来自Super-Real2Sim. 选用的方法(gray)和基准(violet)在第一个arXiv版本的月份(对于没有的伽利略,在会议月份之前)设置.
每张卡片都给机构取名,以及纸上报或要求的东西.
这些方法可以提供多种结果,例如物理双胞胎(配对或分配),模拟准备资产,场景双胞胎,学习模拟器,以及模拟程序.
最近的一个趋势是编码代理编写模拟程序,最近的标准如4DCode Bench,PhysCodeGym,和Video2World被提议来评价这些代理.

blocks.en:
Our research map, Awesome-Real2Sim, currently covers nearly 300 real-to-simulation papers, among them more than 150 methods and 50 benchmarks (Figure 3 ).
It assigns each paper to one primary category, according to what the paper delivers or asks for.
Methods fall into five kinds: physical twins, which simulate specific objects with physical parameters that are either fitted to data or assigned by hand or from priors; simulation-ready assets; scene twins, which are scene-level simulations; simulation programs; and learned simulators.
Benchmarks fall into four kinds: those that ask for a runnable simulation, for answers about physics, or for generated frames, and those that test whether a simulator agrees with reality.
The rest of this section uses this map to place Real2SimLab among methods and benchmarks.
blocks.zh:
我们的研究地图“Super-Real2Sim”目前涵盖近300份真实模拟文件,其中包括150多种方法和50个基准(图3)。
它根据文件的交付或要求,将每份文件归入一个主要类别。
方法可分为五种:物理双胞胎,用物理参数模拟特定物体,这些参数要么适合数据,要么手工或从前科中分配;模拟准备资产;场景双胞胎,即场景模拟;模拟程序;以及学习模拟器。
基准分为四种:要求进行可循环模拟,要求解答物理学或生成的帧,以及测试模拟器是否与现实一致。
本节其余部分使用这张地图将Real2SimLab置于方法和基准之中.

blocks.en:
We highlight three of these kinds, starting with physical twins, which come in two forms.
Fitted twins identify the physical parameters of objects from recordings.
Early works fit a physics engine to videos [ 35 , 36 ] , later works use differentiable simulators [ 15 , 20 ] , and PhysTwin [ 16 ] extends this approach to deformable objects.
Assigned twins instead assign physical properties to the objects of a reconstructed 3D scene, either by hand or from the priors of generative video models, as in PhysGaussian [ 37 ] and PhysDreamer [ 41 ] .
Scene twins rebuild whole environments, such as sensor simulators built from real scans [ 23 ] and simulated rooms in which robot policies are trained before they are deployed in the real world [ 34 , 10 ] .
Simulation programs are the most recent kind: language-model agents write programs that call a physics engine [ 8 , 7 ] , and the newest benchmarks below ask coding agents to write such programs.
Real2SimLab does not propose a new method; instead, it evaluates methods by the programs that they write, and coding agents, which write such programs directly, are its main focus.
blocks.zh:
我们强调其中三种,从双胞胎开始,它们有两种形式。
配对双胞胎从录音中识别物体的物理参数.
早期的作品适合物理引擎拍摄视频[35,36],后来的作品使用不同的模拟器[15,20],而PhysTwin [16]将这种方法扩展到可变形物体.
被指派的双胞胎转而通过手或从基因视频模型的前身给重建的3D场景的物体分配物理属性,如PhysGausian[37]和PhysDreamer[41].
场景双胞胎重建整个环境,如通过真实扫描[23]构建的传感器模拟器,以及模拟室,机器人政策在部署在现实世界之前在其中训练[34,10].
模拟程序是最新的一类:语言模型代理编写程序,称为物理引擎[8,7],下面最新的基准要求编码代理编写此类程序.
Real2SimLab没有提出新方法;相反,它通过它们所编写的程序来评价方法,直接编写此类程序的编码代理是其主要焦点.

blocks.en:
Like methods, benchmarks related to real-to-simulation transfer differ in what they ask a system to deliver.
Benchmarks of physical understanding ask for answers: IntPhys [ 28 ] asks whether an event is physically possible, CLEVRER [ 40 ] asks questions about collisions, and Physion [ 5 ] asks whether objects will touch.
Other benchmarks score generated videos: Physics-IQ [ 24 ] compares them with real recordings of the same event, while VideoPhy [ 4 ] judges their physical commonsense.
IRIS [ 18 ] instead asks for the physical parameters of recorded systems.
The newest benchmarks ask coding agents to write the simulation itself: a script that builds a 4D world in 4DCodeBench [ 32 ] , a Blender scene in PhysCodeGym [ 30 ] , a simulation package in Video2World [ 33 ] , and, from simulated videos, a program with its parameters in PhySimCode [ 19 ] .
BlenderGym [ 12 ] also scores Blender programs by their renders, but it targets the editing of 3D scenes rather than the simulation of recordings.
Finally, SIMPLER [ 21 ] and RobotArena ∞ \infty [ 14 ] simulate real robot setups to evaluate robot policies, so they test a use of real-to-simulation transfer rather than the simulation itself.
blocks.zh:
与方法一样,与真实到模拟转移有关的基准在要求一个系统交付的内容上有所不同。
物理理解的基准要求答案: IntPhys [28] 询问事件在物理上是否可行,CLEVRER [40] 询问碰撞问题,Physion [5] 询问物体是否会触碰.
其他基准分数生成视频:物理-IQ[24]将其与同一事件的真实录音相比较,而VideoPhy[4]则判断其物理常识.
IRIS [18] 转而要求记录系统的物理参数.
最新的基准要求编码代理编写模拟本身:一个在4DCode Bench[32]中构建4D世界的脚本,一个在PhysCodeGym[30]中的Blender场景,一个在Video2World[33]中的模拟包,以及从模拟视频中,一个在PhySimCode[19]中带有参数的程序.
BlenderGym [12] 还得分 Blender程序通过它们的制作,但它的目标是编辑3D场景,而不是模拟录音.
最后,SIMPLER [21] 和RobotArena \\fty [14] 模拟真正的机器人设置来评价机器人政策,因此他们测试使用真实到模拟传输,而不是模拟本身.

blocks.en:
Rather than defining a new benchmark, Real2SimLab runs existing benchmarks through one interface and keeps their own scorers whenever they exist.
It adapts the four newest benchmarks above, namely 4DCodeBench, PhysCodeGym, Video2World, and PhySimCode, as well as Physics-IQ and IRIS.
For these two benchmarks, a method delivers a program instead of frames or parameters.
On Physics-IQ, the program renders the frames that the official scorer evaluates.
IRIS, however, scores recovered parameters rather than simulated motion.
Real2SimLab therefore compares the motion that the program simulates with trajectories extracted from the IRIS videos, so these scores measure reproduction and are not comparable with the parameter-recovery scores of IRIS.
Section 4 describes these 6 benchmarks and our synthetic suite.
Two groups of benchmarks remain outside the scope of Real2SimLab.
Benchmarks that ask only for answers leave no simulation to run, and benchmarks of robot policies, such as SIMPLER, are complementary, since they use simulations built from real setups, whereas Real2SimLab evaluates how such simulations are built.
blocks.zh:
Real2SimLab没有定义新的基准,而是通过一个接口运行现有的基准,并随时保留自己的计分员。
它修改了上面四个最新的基准,即4DCode Bench,PhysCodeGym,Video2World,PhySimCode,以及Physy-IQ和IRIS.
对于这两个基准,一种方法可以交付一个程序而不是帧或参数.
在物理-IQ上,程序使官方计分员评价的帧.
然而,IRIS的评分是恢复参数而不是模拟运动.
Real2SimLab因此将程序模拟的运动与从IRIS视频中提取的轨迹进行比较,因此这些分数衡量复制,与IRIS的参数恢复分数不相上下.
第4节描述了这6项基准和我们的合成套件。
两组基准仍未纳入Real2SimLab的范围。
仅要求答案的基准不留模拟运行,而SIMPLER等机器人政策的基准是互补的,因为它们使用由真实设置构建的模拟,而Real2SimLab则评价这种模拟是如何构建的.

blocks.en:
A model may score well on a benchmark simply because its training data contain the test data [ 29 ] .
Such contamination is hard to detect; for example, rephrased test samples can pass common n-gram decontamination checks [ 39 ] .
Real-to-simulation transfer faces the same risk in another form: when the test data are recordings, one recording can appear in several datasets after re-encoding, resizing, or clipping.
Real2SimLab therefore compares the frames of recordings, both when it creates training data and when it evaluates a trained method (Section 5 ).
blocks.zh:
一个模型可能仅仅因为其培训数据包含测试数据而在一个基准上得分良好[29].
这种污染难以检测;例如,重新表述的试验样品可以通过常见的n克净化检查[39].
真实到模拟的传输在另一种形式上面临同样的风险:当测试数据是录音时,一次录音可以在重新编码,重定大小,或剪辑后出现在多个数据集中.
因此,Real2SimLab在创建培训数据和评价训练方法时比较录音框架(第5节)。

blocks.en: 3  The Real2SimLab Platform
blocks.zh: 3 Real2SimLab 平台

blocks.en:
Figure 4: Architecture of Real2SimLab. A method-wise adapter (left) passes the visible part of a task to a method and collects its deliverable, and a benchmark-wise adapter (right) turns the data of a benchmark into tasks.
In between (center), Real2SimLab fixes one task format.
It builds each deliverable in a sandbox, freezes it, re-runs it offline, and scores it with the protocol of the benchmark.
All results are stored in one record format and reported in one scorecard. Training tasks use the same format as evaluation tasks, and their rewards are computed by the scoring code of evaluation (Section 5 ).
blocks.zh:
图4:Real2SimLab建筑. 一个采用方法的适配器(左)将任务的可见部分传递给一种方法并收集其可交付性,一个采用基准的适配器(右)将基准的数据转化为任务.
在中间, Real2SimLab 修正了一个任务格式。
它将每个可交付品建在一个沙盒中,将其冻结,重新运行下线,并按基准协议进行评分.
所有结果都以一个记录格式保存,并以一个记分卡报告。 培训任务采用与评价任务相同的格式,其奖励由评价评分代码计算(第5节)。

blocks.en:
As discussed in Section 1 , methods are hard to compare because every benchmark defines its own inputs, deliverables, and scoring pipeline.
To address this, Real2SimLab sits between methods and benchmarks (Figure 4 ).
We call the files that a method hands in for a task its deliverable ; a deliverable contains a program, and what the program writes when it runs is its output .
On each task, a method first builds a deliverable from the data that it may see, and Real2SimLab then freezes the deliverable, re-runs its program offline, scores the output of the re-run, and reports the result.
A user describes an evaluation in a short experiment file and runs it with the r2s command-line tool (Listing 3.1 ).
The rest of this section describes the shared task format (Section 3.1 ), how methods build deliverables (Section 3.2 ), how deliverables are frozen and re-run (Section 3.3 ), and how they are scored and reported (Section 3.4 ).
blocks.zh:
如第1节所述,方法难以比较,因为每个基准都界定了自己的投入、交付品和评分管道。
为了解决这个问题,Real2SimLab介于方法和基准之间(图4)。
我们调用一个方法为任务交付的文件; 一个可交付文件包含一个程序, 以及程序运行时所写的是它的输出 。
在每项任务上,一个方法首先从它可能看到的数据中构建一个可交付文件,Real2SimLab然后冻结可交付文件,重新运行其程序离线,对重运行的输出进行评分,并报告结果.
一个用户在一个简短的实验文件中描述一个评价,用r2s命令行工具(Listing 3.1 )运行.
本节其余部分介绍了共同任务格式(第3.1节)、方法如何构建可交付成果(第3.2节)、可交付成果如何被冻结和重新运行(第3.3节)以及如何获得和汇报(第3.4节)。

blocks.en: 3.1  Tasks
blocks.zh: 3.1 任务

blocks.en:
A fair evaluation requires that a method never sees the reference that the scorer uses, so each task splits its data into two parts.
Concretely, a task is a directory with a metadata file and two data directories, visible/ and hidden/ .
The visible/ directory holds everything that a method may see, including the recording, the camera parameters when they are known, and a description of the scene.
The hidden/ directory holds what only the scorer may see, such as the reference output, the inputs of an official scorer, and other recordings of the same event when they exist (Section 3.4 ).
It is never mounted into the sandbox of a method, and task validation rejects a task whose visible part contains hidden content, names hidden files, or holds symbolic links.
blocks.zh:
公平的评价要求一种方法永远看不到计分员使用的参考,因此每个任务将其数据分成两个部分.
具体而言,一个任务是一个包含元数据文件和两个数据目录的目录,可见/和隐藏/.
可见/目录持有一种方法可能看到的一切,包括录音,已知的相机参数,以及对场景的描述.
隐藏/目录持有只有记分员才能看到的东西,如参考输出,官方记分员输入,以及同一事件存在时的其他录音(第3.4节).
它从未被挂载到方法的沙盒中,任务验证拒绝一个其可见部分包含隐藏内容,名称隐藏文件,或持有符号链接的任务.

blocks.en:
Besides the data, the metadata file describes how the task is run: what the method must deliver, namely the convention that the deliverable follows and the output format (Section 3.2 ), the runtime image, which is the container image with the software that the program may use, the time budget, the hardware, and the license of the data.
From this metadata, Real2SimLab generates the task statement that a coding agent reads.
When a benchmark written for coding agents provides its own statement, Real2SimLab uses that statement unchanged.
blocks.zh:
除了数据外,元数据文件还描述了任务是如何运行的:方法必须交付什么,即交付品遵循的常规和输出格式(第3.2节),运行时间图像,即程序可能使用的软件的容器图像,时间预算,硬件,以及数据的许可.
从此元数据, Real2SimLab 生成一个编码代理读取的任务语句 。
当为编码代理编写的基准提供了自己的语句时,Real2SimLab使用该语句不变.

blocks.en: 3.2  Methods and Deliverables
blocks.zh: 3.2 方法和可交付成果

blocks.en:
Benchmarks ask for different deliverables, and methods produce them in different ways.
To connect each side only once, Real2SimLab fixes how a method is called and what it may deliver.
A method is anything that turns the visible part of a task into a deliverable, and its method-wise adapter implements a single call, which receives the visible data and returns a deliverable.
For a coding agent, this call starts the agent in a workspace and collects the program that the agent leaves there.
blocks.zh:
基准要求有不同的交付成果,而方法则以不同的方式产生。
要只连接两侧一次, Real2SimLab 将方法的调用和可以交付的内容固定下来.
一个方法就是将任务可见部分变成可交付的任何东西,它的方法适配器执行一个单调,它接收可见的数据并返回可交付的.
对于编码代理,此调用会在工作空间启动代理,并收集代理离开那里的程序.

blocks.en:
Every deliverable follows one of four conventions, which together cover the 6 benchmarks and our synthetic suite.
Under the convention of Real2SimLab itself, the deliverable is a program, solution/run.py , that writes its output to a given directory, either as object trajectories ( tracks ) or as a video, together with any values that the benchmark asks for, such as the estimated parameters of PhySimCode.
The other three conventions come from the benchmarks themselves: 4DCodeBench asks for a script that builds a 4D world, PhysCodeGym asks for a Blender scene that renders a video, and Video2World asks for a simulation package that contains the reconstructed scene and the actions of the robot.
Since the task statement tells a coding agent which convention to follow, one agent adapter serves every benchmark, so the N + M N+M integrations of Section 1 suffice for coding agents.
blocks.zh:
每个交付品都遵循四项公约中的一项,这两项公约共同涵盖6项基准和我们的合成套件。
根据Real2SimLab的常规本身,交付品是一个程序,溶液/run.py.,将其输出写入给定目录,或者作为对象轨迹(音轨),或者作为视频,以及基准要求的任何值,如PhySimCode的估计参数.
其他三项公约来自基准本身:4DCode 座椅要求一个能构建4D世界的脚本,PhysCodeGym要求一个制作视频的Blender场景,Video2World要求一个包含重建场景和机器人动作的模拟包.
由于任务说明告诉一个编码代理遵循哪种惯例,一个代理适配器为每个基准服务,因此第1节的N+M N+M集成就足以满足编码代理.

blocks.en:
Each coding agent works in its own workspace, which holds a copy of the visible data, the task statement, and the documentation of the output format.
The workspace also provides a small self-check tool, which runs the program twice, as the reproducibility check of Section 3.3 does, and checks that both runs write the same valid output.
Each agent runs in the image that matches the runtime of the task, so it can test its program in the same environment in which the program will later be re-run.
An agent can reach only its model API over the network.
A user may open the network, for example to let an agent install software, but every report then marks the run as such.
Credentials are injected at run time and never written to files, logs, or images, and the logs of agents are redacted before they are stored.
blocks.zh:
每个编码代理在自己的工作空间工作,工作空间持有可见数据的副本,任务说明,以及输出格式的文档.
工作空间还提供了一个小型的自查工具,它像3.3节的可复制性检查那样运行了两次程序,并且检查运行的两种都写入了相同的有效输出.
每个代理运行在符合任务运行时间的图像中,这样它就可以在程序日后重新运行的相同环境中测试自己的程序.
代理只能通过网络达到其模型API.
用户可能打开网络,例如让代理安装软件,但每份报告都会将运行标记为这样的运行.
证书在运行时注入,从不写到文件,日志,或图像,代理的日志在存储前被编辑.

blocks.en: 3.3  Freezing and Re-running
blocks.zh: 3.3 冻结和重新运行

blocks.en:
A score should reflect the program alone, not the session in which the program was written.
Real2SimLab therefore scores the output of a re-run rather than the outputs that a method produced in its session.
To prepare the re-run, it freezes the deliverable, that is, it copies the deliverable and fingerprints the copy.
The frozen program then runs offline, from a read-only directory, without the hidden data, and a re-run refuses any frozen deliverable that no longer matches its fingerprint.
Two sandbox backends enforce these rules: the Docker backend runs each program in a container, and the bubblewrap backend needs neither root access nor a container daemon, so it also works on shared servers and clusters.
A third, local backend runs without isolation for debugging only, and every record that it writes says so.
blocks.zh:
一个分数应该单独反映程序,而不是程序被写入的会话.
因此,Real2SimLab对重新运行的产出进行评分,而不是对届会中某一方法产生的产出进行评分。
为了准备重新运行,它冻结了可交付品,即复制可交付品并打印副本。
被冻结的程序然后从一个只读目录中运行下线,没有隐藏的数据,一个重新运行拒绝任何不再符合其指纹的被冻结的可交付文件.
两个沙盒后端执行这些规则:多克后端在容器中运行每个程序,气泡包后端既不需要根接入,也不需要容器守护进程,因此它也在共享服务器和集群上工作.
第三,本地后端运行时没有隔离,仅用于调试,而其写的每张记录都这么说.

blocks.en:
Re-running also lets Real2SimLab check each deliverable in two ways.
A deliverable is session-consistent if its frozen re-run gives the same output that the method produced in its session, and it is reproducible if two re-runs with the same random seed, which Real2SimLab passes to the program, give the same output.
Both checks compare the full content of the outputs, with a small tolerance for rendering noise in videos, and the scorecard counts how many deliverables pass each check.
blocks.zh:
重运行还让Real2SimLab以两种方式检查每个可交付品.
一个可交付品如果其被冻结的重运行给出的输出与其会话中产生的方法相同,则会符合会话要求;如果两个重运行的随机种子相同,而Real2SimLab通过该程序,则会给出相同的输出,则可以复制.
这两项检查都比较了产出的全部内容,对视频中渲染噪音的容忍度很小,计分卡计算出每次检查有多少可完成的任务。

blocks.en:
Some official protocols, such as those of Physics-IQ and PhysCodeGym, score the output that a method produced in its session.
For such a benchmark, Real2SimLab builds two variants of each task, so that its scores stay comparable with the official protocol.
One variant scores the output of the session, as the official protocol does, and the other, called rerun , scores the output of the frozen re-run.
The two variants are scored as separate tasks, and the scorecard reports both.
Real2SimLab does not re-run Video2World packages itself.
A Video2World package contains the reconstructed scene and the actions of the robot, and executing it in a simulator requires the official code of Video2World.
Therefore, the official evaluator of Video2World executes the frozen package during scoring.
blocks.zh:
一些官方协议,如物理-IQ和物理CodeGym的协议,得分是其会话中的一种方法所产生的输出.
对于这样的基准,Real2SimLab构建了每项任务的两个变体,使其分数与官方协议保持可比性.
一个变体像官方协议一样对会话的输出进行评分,另一个叫做重运行,对冷冻重运行的输出进行评分.
两个变体作为单独的任务得分,计分卡同时报告.
Real2SimLab不重新运行Video2World包本身.
视频2 World package包含重建的场景和机器人的动作,在模拟器中执行需要Video2World的官方代码.
因此,Video2World的官方评价人员在评分期间执行冷冻包.

blocks.en: 3.4  Scoring and Reporting
blocks.zh: 3.4 评分和报告

blocks.en:
Each benchmark already defines what a good result is, so Real2SimLab keeps the original scorer of each benchmark whenever one applies.
Each deliverable is scored with one of two protocols, and the variant of Section 3.3 decides whether the output of the session or that of the re-run is scored.
The native protocol runs the official scorer from a checkout at a pinned commit and stores its report unchanged, so its headline number is the metric that the benchmark itself reports; 5 of the 6 benchmarks use it.
The reproduction protocol serves the data for which no official scorer of the program output applies: our synthetic suite, recordings of users, and IRIS, whose own scorer evaluates recovered parameters instead of simulated motion.
It compares the object trajectories of the re-run with the hidden reference.
blocks.zh:
每个基准都已经定义了什么是好结果,因此Real2SimLab在适用时都会保留每个基准的原始计分符.
每份可交付品均以两个协议之一得分,由第3.3节的变体决定会话或重运行的产出是得分.
本地协议运行官方计分器从一个固定承诺的退票中运行,并保留其报告不变,因此其标题号是基准本身报告的衡量标准;6个基准中的5个使用它.
复制协议服务于没有应用程序输出的官方计分器的数据:我们的合成套件,用户的录音,以及由自己的计分器评价回收参数而不是模拟运动的IRIS.
它比较了重运行的物体轨迹和隐藏的参考物.

blocks.en:
The headline number of the reproduction protocol is the reproduction skill , defined as 1 − e / e static 1-e/e_{\text{static}} .
Here, e e is the error of the deliverable under the primary metric that the metadata of the task names, such as the mean distance between the simulated and the recorded positions of the objects, and e static e_{\text{static}} is the error of a static scene in which every object stays at its first position.
A skill of 1 means that the deliverable reproduces the reference exactly, a skill of 0 means that it does no better than a static scene, and a negative skill means that it does worse.
When the hidden part of a task holds other recordings of the same event, Real2SimLab also scores each of them against the reference as if it were a deliverable.
Their skill measures how much the real event varies when it is repeated, and a deliverable that exceeds this skill matches the reference more closely than a second recording of the same event does.
blocks.zh:
复制协议头号是复制技能 – e / e 静态 1- e / e_{\text{ static} 。
在此,e是任务名称元数据的主要度量下可交付文件的错误,如模拟对象与记录对象位置之间的平均距离,e 静态 e__text{static}是每个对象停留在第一位置的静态场景的错误.
1的技巧意味着可交付品确切地复制了参考文献,0的技巧意味着它不会比静态场景更好,负技巧意味着它会更糟糕.
当一项任务的隐藏部分持有同一事件的其他录音时,Real2SimLab也会根据参考文献对每个记录进行评分,仿佛它是可交付的.
他们的技巧衡量真实事件在重复发生时的不同程度,超过这一技能的交付品比同一事件的第二次记录更贴近参考。

blocks.en:
A score should also reflect the method rather than the machine.
When the machine fails, for example when a sandbox does not start or an official scorer crashes, Real2SimLab records an infrastructure error instead of a score, leaves it out of every statistic, and redoes the step the next time the experiment runs.
Every step of an experiment is also keyed by the content of its inputs, so an interrupted experiment resumes where it stopped, and a finished step is reused only while its inputs stay unchanged.
blocks.zh:
得分还应反映方法而不是机器.
当机器失效时,例如当沙盒没有启动或官方计分器崩溃时,Real2SimLab记录了一个基础设施错误而不是一个计分器,将它从每个统计中忽略出来,并在下一次实验运行时重做步骤.
实验的每一个步骤也都按着其输入内容键,所以中断的实验恢复到停止的地方,一个完成的步骤只有在其输入不变的情况下才能再利用.

blocks.en:
All results share one record format with versioned schemas.
From these records, a scorecard reports the headline number of each benchmark over its tasks, aggregated in the same way as in the original benchmark, or averaged over tasks under the reproduction protocol, with a bootstrap confidence interval over tasks and repeated runs.
Each headline number appears next to reference points on the same tasks, such as the score of a static scene, of another recording of the event, or of the solution released with the benchmark, so that a reader can judge whether a score is high or low.
blocks.zh:
所有结果都采用一个有版本计划的记录格式。
从这些记录中,一个记分卡报告每个基准在其任务上的标题编号,其汇总方式与原始基准相同,或对复制协议下的任务进行平均值,对任务和重复运行有一个靴子套置信任间隔。
每个标题编号出现在相同任务的参考点旁边,如静态场景的得分,事件的另一个记录,或以基准发布的解决方案,这样读者就可以判断一个分数是高是低.

blocks.en: 4  Ecosystem
blocks.zh: 4 生态系统

blocks.en: This section describes the benchmarks and methods that Real2SimLab connects so far, how we check each benchmark-wise adapter, and how users can extend the platform.
blocks.zh: 本节介绍Real2SimLab迄今为止连接的基准和方法,我们如何检查每个基于基准的适配器,用户如何扩展平台.

blocks.en:
So far, Real2SimLab adapts 6 existing benchmarks and provides a synthetic suite of our own (Figure 5 ).
Each benchmark-wise adapter downloads the original data at a pinned revision and builds task directories from it.
It also states which official protocol it follows and which parts of the benchmark it leaves out.
Of the 6 benchmarks, 5 keep their official scorers through the native protocol.
IRIS publishes videos of real physical systems but no trajectories, so its adapter extracts the trajectory of the ball from each video and scores deliverables with the reproduction protocol.
The adapter covers the class of IRIS in which a ball is dropped, one of eight classes.
Our synthetic suite renders five phenomena with exact ground truth: a bouncing ball, a damped pendulum, a sliding block, a projectile with drag, and a collision between two balls.
Because its ground truth is exact, the suite serves both as a check of the reproduction protocol and as a source of training tasks (Section 5 ).
blocks.zh:
迄今为止,Real2SimLab调整了6个现有基准,并提供了我们自己的合成套件(图5)。
每个面向基准的适配器都会在被绑定的修订版下载原始数据,并从中构建任务目录.
它还说明它所遵循的官方协议和它所遗漏的基准的哪些部分。
在6个基准中,有5个通过本土协议保持官方计分员.
IRIS发布真实物理系统的视频但没有轨迹,因此它的适配器从每段视频中提取球的轨迹,并用复制协议对可达到的目标进行评分.
适配器涵盖投球的IRIS级,8级之一.
我们的合成套房 制造了五种现象 准确的地面真理: 一个弹球,一个被挡住的圆柱形,一个滑动的块,一个拖曳的抛射物,以及两个球之间的碰撞。
由于其真实性,套房既可以检查复制协议,也可以作为培训任务的来源(第5节)。

blocks.en:
Figure 5: The benchmarks that Real2SimLab adapts so far. Each card shows what a method sees, what it delivers, and how the deliverable is scored.
Of the 6 existing benchmarks, 5 keep their official scorers, while IRIS (marked Lab ) and our synthetic suite (marked exact truth ) use the reproduction skill of Real2SimLab.
New benchmarks and recordings of users are added by converting them into tasks of the shared format (Section 3.1 ).
blocks.zh:
图5:Real2SimLab迄今调整的基准。 每张卡片都显示一种方法所看到的,它交付的,以及交付品如何得分.
在现有的6个基准中,5个保留了他们的正式计分员,而IRIS(标志性实验室)和我们的合成套件(标志性准确的真相)则使用Real2SimLab的复制技能.
新的基准和用户录音通过转换成共同格式的任务而增加(第3.1节)。

blocks.en:
We check each benchmark-wise adapter against the original release of its benchmark.
For example, the scores that the Physics-IQ adapter reports equal those of the official pipeline on the same videos, and the reference packages of Video2World reproduce their recorded scores on Push-T, a planar pushing task.
On the synthetic suite, the program that generated the data reaches a reproduction skill of 1.
These checks also revealed a few issues in the released data, such as two IRIS recordings that are copies of each other, and the adapters work around and document such issues.
blocks.zh:
我们对照基准的最初发布情况,检查每个基准适配器。
例如,Physics-IQ适配器报告的得分等于同一视频上的官方管道的得分,而Video2World的参考包在Push-T上复制了他们的记录得分,这个计划推进任务.
在合成套房上,生成数据的程序达到了1的复制技能.
这些检查还揭示了发布数据中的几个问题,例如两个IRIS录音相互复制,适配器围绕这些问题工作并记录下来.

blocks.en:
Through a bridge to Harbor 0.27 [ 13 ] , Real2SimLab connects all 47 agents of Harbor, such as OpenHands, Aider, Cursor CLI, Goose, and Qwen Code.
A bridged agent works in a Harbor container built from the runtime image of the task, with a network that reaches only the model API.
After the agent finishes, Real2SimLab freezes its program and re-runs it offline before scoring.
In addition, Codex, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, and mini-SWE-agent [ 38 ] have direct adapters, which run these 5 agents in the sandboxes of Real2SimLab without Harbor.
Since Real2SimLab limits the network of every agent and re-runs every program, an agent adapter only needs to state how to call its tool and which credentials to inject.
Besides these agents, Real2SimLab includes 5 simple non-agent methods, which serve as references and examples.
blocks.zh:
通过一座通往港湾0.27[13]的桥梁,Real2SimLab连接了港湾的所有47名特工,如OpenHands,Aider,Cursor CLI,Goose,以及Quen Code.
一个桥式代理在从任务运行时的图像所建的港湾容器中工作,其网络只达到模型API.
在代理完成后,Real2SimLab冻结其程序,并在评分前重新运行下线.
此外,Codex,Claude Code,双子座CLI,OpenCode,以及迷你-SWE-agent[38]都有直接的适配器,这些适配器在Real2SimLab无港沙盒中运行这5个代理.
由于Real2SimLab限制了每个代理的网络,并重新运行每个程序,一个代理适配器只需要说明如何调用其工具以及哪些证书可以注入.
除了这些代理,Real2SimLab还包括5种简单的非代理方法,作为参考和实例.

blocks.en:
Benchmarks, methods, metrics, output formats, scorers, sandbox backends, and commands are all plugins.
Their interfaces follow a versioned specification of tasks, deliverables, and records, and within version 1, new releases only add optional fields, so existing plugins keep working.
Real2SimLab also ships agent skills , which are step-by-step procedures that a coding agent can follow to add a benchmark, add a method, or turn a recording into validated tasks.
Through these plugins and agent skills, we hope that the Real2SimHub community will extend Real2SimLab with new benchmarks, methods, and recordings.
blocks.zh:
基准,方法,度量衡,输出格式,计分器,沙盒后端,命令都是插件.
他们的界面遵循一个版本化的任务,可交付品,和记录的规格,在版本1中,新发行只添加可选字段,因此现有的插件继续工作.
Real2SimLab 同时也是船舶代理技能,这是编码代理可以遵循的分步程序,用于添加基准,添加方法,或者将记录转化为验证的任务.
通过这些插件和代理技能,我们希望Real2SimHub社区将用新的基准,方法和录音来扩展Real2SimLab.

blocks.en: 5  Training with Real2SimLab
blocks.zh: 5 实训2SimLab

blocks.en:
Figure 6: The training data pipeline. (1) Training tasks come from recordings of users, from a released training split when a benchmark has one, or from our generator of synthetic scenes, and they use the format of evaluation tasks.
(2) The overlap check removes every task that shows the recording of an evaluation task, by comparing thumbnails of the frames in which something moves, at every time offset.
In the example, a PhysCodeGym clip, treated here as a candidate for training, contains the hidden test video of a Physics-IQ evaluation task, starting 3 s into the clip.
(3) The dataset holds the tasks and the runs on them, and each run holds a program, its reward, and the log of the agent.
(4) A trainer of the user’s choice trains a method offline on the dataset, or online with rewards from the evaluation code.
(5) Real2SimLab evaluates the trained method as in Section 3 , but skips the evaluation tasks that overlap its training tasks.
Real2SimLab provides all steps but the trainer; we have not yet trained a model with them.
blocks.zh:
图 6:培训数据管道。 (1)培训任务来自用户的录音,在基准有基准时解开的训练,或来自我们合成场景的生成者,他们使用评价任务的格式.
(2)重叠检查通过比较某个东西移动的帧的缩略图,每次抵消时,都会删除显示一个评价任务记录的每一个任务.
举例来说,一个在这里作为培训候选对象的PhysCodeGym剪辑包含一个物理-智商评价任务的隐藏测试视频,从3s开始进入剪辑.
(3)数据集掌握各项任务及其运行情况,每一次运行都持有程序,其奖励,代理的日志.
(4) 用户选择的训练员在数据集上培训一种离线方法,或从评价代码中获得奖励的在线方法。
(5) Real2SimLab像第3节一样评价训练方法,但跳过与训练任务重叠的评价任务.
Real2SimLab除了训练员之外,还提供所有步骤;我们还没有与他们一起培训一个模型。

blocks.en:
Besides evaluation, Real2SimLab provides a pipeline that creates training data with reward annotations for real-to-simulation methods (Figure 6 ).
The pipeline builds training tasks, filters out every task whose recording appears in an evaluation task, and annotates the programs that methods write for the remaining tasks with rewards.
All of these steps follow one rule: each recording serves either training or evaluation, never both.
Real2SimLab does not ship a trainer or model weights; it provides the data and the rewards, and it keeps a trained method away from the evaluation tasks that overlap its training data.
blocks.zh:
除了评价外,Real2SimLab还提供一条管道,用于创建培训数据,并附有真实到模拟方法的奖励说明(图6)。
管道构建了培训任务,过滤了在评价任务中出现记录的每一项任务,并且对为剩余任务编写方法的程序做了说明,并给予奖励。
所有这些步骤都遵循一条规则:每次录制都服务于培训或评价,而不是两者兼而有之。
Real2SimLab不运送教练员或模型权重;它提供数据和奖励,并使训练有素的方法远离与其培训数据重叠的评价任务.

blocks.en:
A training task has the format of an evaluation task but is marked for training, and its hidden part holds the labels, such as the reference trajectories, the true parameters, and the true program.
Users can turn their own recordings, together with reference outputs such as object trajectories, into training tasks with the same builder that writes evaluation tasks, and a benchmark-wise adapter can build a training split when a benchmark releases one under terms that allow training.
None of the 6 benchmarks does so: they are released for evaluation, and Real2SimLab treats them as evaluation sets.
For example, the terms of Physics-IQ forbid using its test data to improve a score, so Real2SimLab never exports Physics-IQ tasks for training.
To provide training data nonetheless, Real2SimLab can generate any number of training scenes of the five synthetic phenomena, with exact labels and the true program, and these scenes are the main source of training data today.
Each scene is rendered anew from parameters drawn from fixed ranges, and to avoid near copies of an evaluation scene, a draw is kept only if at least one parameter differs by more than 5% from that of the evaluation task of the same phenomenon.
blocks.zh:
训练任务具有评价任务的格式,但被标记为训练,其隐藏部分持有标签,如参考轨迹,真实参数,以及真实程序.
用户可以将自己的录音,以及对象轨迹等参考产出,转化为与编写评价任务的同一构建器的训练任务,一个基于基准的适配器可以在一个基准发布一个允许训练的条款时构建一个训练分割.
6个基准中没有一个是这样做的:它们被公布用于评价,Real2SimLab将它们视为评价集.
例如,物理-IQ的条款禁止利用其测试数据来提高一个分数,因此Real2SimLab从不输出物理-IQ任务来进行培训.
尽管如此,为了提供培训数据,Real2SimLab可以产生五个合成现象的任何数量的培训场景,并带有准确的标签和真实的程序,这些场景是当今培训数据的主要来源.
每个场景都从固定范围的参数中重新产生,为了避免接近评价场景的副本,只有在至少一个参数与同一现象的评价任务有5%以上的差异时,才保留图纸.

blocks.en:
Before writing a dataset, Real2SimLab compares every training task with the evaluation tasks and leaves out each task that overlaps one of them, which guards against data contamination.
Two tasks overlap if they share a file or show the same recording.
To detect the same recording, Real2SimLab reduces the frames in which something moves to small thumbnails and compares them at every time offset, so that it also catches copies that are re-encoded, resized, clipped, brightened, or reduced to a lower frame rate.
In our tests, the check found 36 of 40 such copies of the synthetic evaluation videos, missing only the most heavily compressed ones, and near its threshold, it errs toward leaving a task out.
On real data, it found each of the 27 clips that PhysCodeGym reuses from Physics-IQ, which shows that a dataset assembled from public recordings can indeed contain the test videos of a benchmark.
blocks.zh:
在写入数据集之前,Real2SimLab将每项培训任务与评价任务进行比较,并省去与其中一项任务重叠的每个任务,防止数据污染.
如果共享一个文件或显示相同的录音,有两个任务重叠.
为了探测到同样的录音,Real2SimLab会减少某物移动到小缩略图的帧,并在每次抵消时进行比较,这样它也会捕获重新编码,调整大小,剪切,亮度,或降低到较低的帧速率.
在我们的测试中, 检查发现40个这样的拷贝中, 有36个只缺少最压缩的,
在真实数据上,它发现了物理-IQ中PhysCodeGym再利用的27个片段的每个片段,这表明从公开录音中收集的数据集确实可以包含一个基准的测试视频.

blocks.en:
For each training task, a method, such as a coding agent, writes a program in the same way as in an evaluation, and Real2SimLab annotates the program with a reward.
The reward is the score that the evaluation of the task would give the program, computed by exactly the same code: Real2SimLab freezes the program, runs it offline, and scores its output.
Since the training tasks are synthetic scenes or recordings of users, this score is the reproduction skill of Section 3.4 , and the official scorers of the 6 benchmarks, whose data are never used for training, serve evaluation only.
A failure outside the program, such as a sandbox that does not start, gives no reward rather than a reward of 0, so a trainer can tell failures of the method apart from failures of the platform.
Real2SimLab then exports the training tasks and these runs as one dataset, in which each run holds the program, its reward, and the redacted log of the agent.
blocks.zh:
对于每个训练任务,一个方法,如编码代理,以与评价相同的方式写一个程序,Real2SimLab以奖励的方式对程序进行注释.
奖励是任务评价会给程序分数,用完全相同的代码计算: Real2SimLab 冻结程序,运行下线,并评分其输出.
由于训练任务为合成场景或用户录音,因此这个分数是第3.4节的复制技能,而6个基准的官方计分者,其数据从未用于训练,只服务于评价.
程序外的失败,如一个不启动的沙盒,没有奖赏而不是0的奖赏,因此训练员除了平台的失败之外,还可以分辨失败的方法.
Real2SimLab然后导出训练任务,这些任务作为一个数据集运行,其中每个运行都持有程序,它的奖励,以及代理商的编辑日志.

blocks.en:
The rewards stored in a dataset serve offline training, such as fine-tuning on high-reward programs and preference learning [ 27 ] on pairs of programs for the same task.
For online reinforcement learning, each new program can be scored as soon as it is generated, directly or through a Harbor task whose verifier computes the same reward, and since each reward covers a whole program, group-relative methods such as GRPO [ 31 ] and RLOO [ 1 ] suit this setting.
We have not yet trained a model in these ways.
blocks.zh:
存储在数据集中的奖励服务于离线培训,如高回报程序的微调和相同任务的对子程序的偏好学习[27].
对于在线强化学习来说,每个新程序一旦生成,就可以直接或通过一个由核查者计算出相同奖励的港务来获得分数,由于每个奖励都涵盖整个程序,因此GRPO[31]和RLOO[1]等群体关系方法适合这个设置.
我们尚未以这些方式培训一个模式。

blocks.en:
A dataset is checked only against the evaluation tasks given when it is exported, so the overlap check runs again when a trained method is evaluated.
When a method is trained on an exported dataset through Real2SimLab, the thumbnails of its training tasks are stored with the trained model, and in every later evaluation, Real2SimLab skips each task that overlaps one of them and marks it as not held out, so the score covers held-out tasks only.
blocks.zh:
仅对照输出时给出的评价任务来检查数据集,因此在评价训练有素的方法时重复检查再次运行.
当通过Real2SimLab对输出数据集进行方法培训时,其训练任务的缩略图会与经过训练的模型一起存储,在以后的每次评价中,Real2SimLab跳过与其中之一重叠的每一个任务,并标记为不坚守,因此分数只涵盖被扣留的任务.

blocks.en: 6  Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We have presented Real2SimLab, a unified platform for real-to-simulation transfer.
Real2SimLab runs the program that a method writes and evaluates the output simulation with the original scorer of each benchmark.
As a result, the program becomes the common interface between methods and benchmarks.
Evaluating N N methods on M M benchmarks then requires only N + M N+M integrations instead of N × M N\times M .
Moreover, Real2SimLab creates training data by filtering out the video recordings that appear in any evaluation task, and provides the reward scores for future fine-tuning.
So far, Real2SimLab supports 47 coding agents and 5 non-agent methods on 6 benchmarks.
We also release Awesome-Real2Sim, a research map of nearly 300 real-to-simulation papers, to help researchers choose baseline methods and benchmarks when positioning a new work.
Both the platform and the research map are open source, and we hope that they will grow into a shared effort of the Real2SimHub community.
blocks.zh:
我们提出了Real2SimLab,一个用于真实到模拟传输的统一平台.
Real2SimLab运行一个方法用每个基准的原始计分器编写和评价输出模拟的程序.
因此,程序成为方法和基准之间的共同接口.
在MM基准上评价NN方法,则只需要N+M N+M集成,而不是N×M N\times M.
此外,Real2SimLab通过过滤任何评价任务中出现的录像,创建培训数据,并为未来的微调提供奖励分数.
至今,Real2SimLab支持47个编码代理和5个非代理方法的6个基准.
我们还发行了"真棒-Real2Sim"(英語:Super-Real2Sim),这是一张近300份真实到模拟论文的研究地图,帮助研究人员在定位新作品时选择基准方法和基准.
平台和研究地图都是开源的,我们希望它们能成长为Real2SimHub社区的共同努力.
